product_metadata.title: Large Relax Plush Reading Pillow | Shredded Memory Foam Bedrest TV Pillow with Armrests | Great for Adults, Teens, & Pregnant Woman | Neck, Upper Back, Lumbar, & Coccyx Lower Back Support Cushion
features: PREMIUM SUPPORT: Ergonomically designed, our reading pillow provides support and comfort while reducing pressure on the lower back. The Pillow Palace Bed Rest Pillow will give you the perfect head, neck, arm, and full back support, while reading, watching TV, or just relaxing. This bedding alternative is perfect for all ages - made for adults, teens, kids and even pregnant women.

MULTIPURPOSE: Because of its compact size, it fits nicely anywhere. You can put it on your bed, your chair, or just keep it on the floor and sit with it, while it comfortably supports your body. Whether your watching TV, snuggled up with a book or simply lounging around, the LEXIA Bed Rest Pillow is the relaxing accessory for you.

COMFORTABLE & BREATHABLE: Our back reading pillow is manufactured with shredded shapeable clusters of foam, which allows for a better airflow, in addition to a flexibility, to personalize the molding of the pillow, to the comfort of each individual. Its soft plush gray velour cover, makes the pillow extremely cozy and comfortable to snuggle up on, no matter where you are in the home

ANYWHERE, ANYTIME: The Back Reading Pillow has a built-in handle so you can easily carry it with you wherever you go. From room to room this cushion is fully portable so you can even use on the go and in various locations for pain relief and comfort at all times.

EASY TO CLEAN: When in contact with dirt, simply spot clean it with a damp cloth and detergent to keep your pillow looking clean and new. And, if you don't absolutely love your Pillow Palace Back Reading Pillow we guarantee you that we will reimburse you for 100% of your order.
description: The Lexia Pillow Palace reading pillow is ergonomically designed to provide support and comfort while reading on watching tv on your bed or couch. The bedrest pillow provides excellent lumbar, coccyx lower back, neck and head support while resting upright on the bed.

Designed for pregnant women to offer relief after a long day, this pillow is extremely helpful for just about anyone who needs lumbar support while they rest. The pillow can be used on the bed or couch and even on the floor.

The Pillow Palace pillow is made from high-grade memory foam which had been shredded to create a one of a kind pillow that provides comfort and support. This pillow will help keep your body relaxed while sitting up on the bed and enjoying a good book or tv show.
